name: Draft, Sketch, and Prove (DSP)
one_liner: Maps informal mathematical proofs into formal Isabelle/HOL proof sketches and discharges the open subgoals with Sledgehammer ATPs.

loop.proposes: An LLM drafts an informal mathematical proof and translates it into a formal Isabelle/HOL proof sketch with open `sledgehammer` subgoals.
loop.judged_by: Isabelle/HOL and automated theorem provers (E, SPASS, Vampire, Z3, CVC4 via Sledgehammer) verify each intermediate step.
loop.steers: Sketches are sampled independently; a problem counts as solved if any sketch is completed.

headline_result: Solved 39.3% of miniF2F test theorems in Isabelle/HOL, a more than 10 percentage point jump over prior direct tactic-generation baselines.
caveat: If the high-level proof sketch omits a bridge lemma too large for Sledgehammer to close within its timeout, the whole sketch fails.
beyond_harness_note: The LLM supplies the high-level proof skeleton while superposition and SMT theorem provers (Sledgehammer) discharge the leaf obligations.
algorithmic_authority: Isabelle/HOL kernel and Sledgehammer automated theorem provers

sources.title: Draft, Sketch, and Prove: Guiding Formal Theorem Provers with Informal Proofs (arXiv:2210.12283, first posted 2022-10-21)

verification.notes: Checked against Jiang et al., ICLR 2023. Year corrected 2023 to 2022 (first posting); ICLR 2023 is not printed on the arXiv page, so it was removed from the source title (ledger).
